title: He said (that) he… He told me (that) he…
translation: 他曾说他…… 他曾告诉我说他……
description: A picture lesson on reported speech: 'He said (that) he…' and 'He told me (that) he…'. Twelve pictures in four groups of three show direct speech being converted to reported speech (tired / reading / dinner / homework), illustrating the backshift of tenses (present → past, present perfect → past perfect). The lesson introduces written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 133 conversation using reported speech), B (answer 'What did he/she say?' with 'He/She said (that)…'), C (answer 'What did he/she tell you?' with 'He/She told me (that)…'), and D (answer with past perfect). The workbook drills reported-speech completion for a Ben Gold interview and open-ended situation questions; the grammar workbook rewrites sentences with 'said'/'told', completes a reported-speech dialogue, and writes short reports from given facts.
answer_note: The listening captions are model answers (suggested). Textbook written exercises A (answer questions about the Lesson 133 conversation), B ('What did he/she say?'), C ('What did he/she tell you?'), and D (past perfect reported speech) are model answers (suggested). Workbook A (Ben Gold interview reported-speech completion) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-129-135.jpg p.216); Workbook B (situations) has no printed key, so the answers are model answers (suggested). Grammar I (rewrite with said/told), II (complete reported-speech dialogue), and III (write short reports) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.569-570).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

1. I'm tired.
2. What did he say? What did he tell you?
3. He said (that) he was tired. He told me (that) he was tired.
4. I'm reading.
5. What did she say? What did she tell you?
6. She said (that) she was reading. She told me (that) she was reading.
7. We want our dinner.
8. What did they say? What did they tell you?
9. They said (that) they wanted their dinner. They told me (that) they wanted their dinner.
10. I've finished my homework.
11. What did he say? What did he tell you?
12. He said (that) he had finished his homework. He told me (that) he had finished his homework.
lesson.translation: 1. 我累了。 2. 他说了什么？他告诉了你什么？ 3. 他（说）他累了。他告诉我（说）他累了。 4. 我正在读书。 5. 她说了什么？她告诉了你什么？ 6. 她（说）她正在读书。她告诉我（说）她正在读书。 7. 我们要我们的晚餐。 8. 他们说了什么？他们告诉了你什么？ 9. 他们（说）他们想要晚餐。他们告诉我（说）他们想要晚餐。 10. 我已经做完作业了。 11. 他说了什么？他告诉了你什么？ 12. 他（说）他已做完作业。他告诉我（说）他已做完作业。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
lesson.context: One question per picture (12 pictures in 4 groups of 3); the answer is the reported-speech conversion shown in the picture captions.

questions.prompt: Picture 1: What is he saying?
questions.answer: I'm tired.

questions.prompt: Picture 2: What did he say? What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He said (that) he was tired. He told me (that) he was tired.

questions.prompt: Picture 3: What did he say? What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He said (that) he was tired. He told me (that) he was tired.

questions.prompt: Picture 4: What is she saying?
questions.answer: I'm reading.

questions.prompt: Picture 5: What did she say? What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She said (that) she was reading. She told me (that) she was reading.

questions.prompt: Picture 6: What did she say? What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She said (that) she was reading. She told me (that) she was reading.

questions.prompt: Picture 7: What are they saying?
questions.answer: We want our dinner.

questions.prompt: Picture 8: What did they say? What did they tell you?
questions.answer: They said (that) they wanted their dinner. They told me (that) they wanted their dinner.

questions.prompt: Picture 9: What did they say? What did they tell you?
questions.answer: They said (that) they wanted their dinner. They told me (that) they wanted their dinner.

questions.prompt: Picture 10: What is he saying?
questions.answer: I've finished my homework.

questions.prompt: Picture 11: What did he say? What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He said (that) he had finished his homework. He told me (that) he had finished his homework.

questions.prompt: Picture 12: What did he say? What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He said (that) he had finished his homework. He told me (that) he had finished his homework.

lesson.title: Written A: Answer the questions (reported speech)
lesson.instruction: Read the conversation in Lesson 133 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 133 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 重读第 133 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 7 comprehension questions about the Lesson 133 conversation (reporter and actress), answered using reported speech.

questions.prompt: What is she? What did she say?
questions.answer: She is a reporter. She said (that) she was a reporter.

questions.prompt: Did she make a new film? What did she say?
questions.answer: Yes, she did. She said (that) she had just made a new film.

questions.prompt: Is she going to retire? What did she say?
questions.answer: No, she isn't. She said (that) she wasn't going to retire.

questions.prompt: How does she feel? What did she say?
questions.answer: She feels tired. She said (that) she felt tired.

questions.prompt: Is she going to make another film? What did she say?
questions.answer: No, she isn't. She said (that) she wasn't going to make another film for a long time.

questions.prompt: When did she arrive? What did she tell reporters?
questions.answer: She arrived at London Airport. She told reporters (that) she felt very tired and (that) she didn't want to make another film for a long time.

questions.prompt: What was she wearing? What did she say?
questions.answer: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat. She said (that) she was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.

lesson.title: Written B: What did he/she say?
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 items; item 1 ('I'm tired.' → He said (that) he was tired.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: 'I'm tired.' → What did he say?
questions.answer: He said (that) he was tired.

questions.prompt: 'I'm reading.' → What did she say?
questions.answer: She said (that) she was reading.

questions.prompt: 'We want our dinner.' → What did they say?
questions.answer: They said (that) they wanted their dinner.

questions.prompt: 'I've finished my homework.' → What did he say?
questions.answer: He said (that) he had finished his homework.

lesson.title: Written C: What did he/she tell you?
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 items; item 1 ('I'm tired.' → He told me (that) he was tired.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: 'I'm tired.' → What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He told me (that) he was tired.

questions.prompt: 'I'm reading.' → What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She told me (that) she was reading.

questions.prompt: 'We want our dinner.' → What did they tell you?
questions.answer: They told me (that) they wanted their dinner.

questions.prompt: 'I've finished my homework.' → What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He told me (that) he had finished his homework.

lesson.title: Written D: What did he/she tell you? (past perfect)
lesson.instruction: Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 模仿例句回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 items with past perfect; item 1 ('I've finished my homework.' → He told me (that) he had finished his homework.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: 'I've finished my homework.' → What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He told me (that) he had finished his homework.

questions.prompt: 'I have just made a new CD.' → What did he tell you?
questions.answer: He told me (that) he had just made a new CD.

questions.prompt: 'I have been to the doctor.' → What did she tell you?
questions.answer: She told me (that) she had been to the doctor.

questions.prompt: 'We have lost our tickets.' → What did they tell you?
questions.answer: They told me (that) they had lost their tickets.

practice.title: Practice A: He said that… and He told me that…
practice.instruction: Look at the table. Then read the interview and write a simple report of what Ben Gold said to you. 看下表，阅读采访，根据 Ben 的回答写出一个简短的报道。
practice.translation: 看下表，阅读采访，根据 Ben 的回答写出一个简短的报道。
practice.context: 6 reported-speech fill-in items; item 1 (Ben told me (that) he was 35 this year and (that) he still worked hard.) is the printed example. The table shows: 'I am right.' → he was right; 'I am driving carefully.' → he was driving carefully; 'I feel ill.' → he felt ill; 'I have read the newspaper.' → he had read the newspaper. The dialogue is an interview with pop star Ben Gold.

questions.prompt: Ben told me (that) he was 35 this year and (that) he still worked hard.
questions.answer: Ben told me (that) he was 35 this year and (that) he still worked hard.

questions.prompt: He said (that) he had just made a new CD.
questions.answer: He said (that) he had just made a new CD.

questions.prompt: He told me (that) he wanted to have a long holiday.
questions.answer: He told me (that) he wanted to have a long holiday.

questions.prompt: He said (that) he wasn't going to record any more songs this year.
questions.answer: He said (that) he wasn't going to record any more songs this year.

questions.prompt: He told me (that) he hadn't done everything he wanted to do yet.
questions.answer: He told me (that) he hadn't done everything he wanted to do yet.

questions.prompt: He said (that) someone had asked him to be in a film next year.
questions.answer: He said (that) someone had asked him to be in a film next year.

practice.title: Practice B: Situations
practice.instruction: Read these situations. What might you say in each? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.translation: 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。
practice.context: 3 open-ended situation questions; the workbook answer key gives only possible sample answers.

questions.prompt: You think you and a friend should go home now. How do you suggest it?
questions.answer: Let's go home now.

questions.prompt: An English lady said something but you didn't quite understand it. How do you ask an English friend what she said?
questions.answer: What did she say?

questions.prompt: You hear that a friend's family is leaving your town. 'Why?' you wonder. What do you say?
questions.answer: I wonder why.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences using 'said' or 'told'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 said 或 told 改写以下句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 said 或 told 改写以下句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.569 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 sentence-rewrite items; item 1 (You're late! (the teacher, me) → The teacher told me (that) I was late.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: You're late! (the teacher, me)
questions.answer: The teacher told me (that) I was late.

questions.prompt: Where's the nearest police station? (the stranger, him)
questions.answer: The stranger asked him where the nearest police station was.

questions.prompt: I'm going to take my exams in the spring. (his daughter, his parents)
questions.answer: His daughter told her parents (that) she was going to take her exams in the spring.

questions.prompt: We've got tickets for the football match. (they, him)
questions.answer: They told him (that) they had got tickets for the football match.

questions.prompt: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year? (his wife, him)
questions.answer: His wife asked him where he was going to spend his holidays that year.

questions.prompt: I may go abroad with my wife. (Gary, his friend)
questions.answer: Gary told his friend (that) he might go abroad with his wife.

questions.prompt: Don't be so sure! We might not go anywhere! (Gary, his friend)
questions.answer: Gary told his friend not to be so sure; they might not go anywhere.

questions.prompt: We'd better hurry. (the doctor, his patient)
questions.answer: The doctor told his patient that they'd better hurry.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Complete the dialogue (reported speech)
grammar.instruction: 完成以下对话，填入适当的词（间接引语）。
grammar.translation: 完成以下对话，填入适当的词（间接引语）。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.569 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 fill-in items in a dialogue about a woman's holiday plans (retirement, new film, travel arrangements).

questions.prompt: She told him (___) she might retire.
questions.answer: that

questions.prompt: She said (___) she couldn't make up her mind.
questions.answer: that

questions.prompt: She said that she was not sure if she ___ go abroad.
questions.answer: might

questions.prompt: She said she might go to Egypt, but she ___ make up her mind yet.
questions.answer: hadn't

questions.prompt: She told him that her husband wanted to go to France ___ a long holiday.
questions.answer: for

questions.prompt: She said that the house ___ look after while they were away.
questions.answer: must

questions.prompt: She said that she would ___ her brother to look after the house.
questions.answer: ask

questions.prompt: She told him that the garden needed to ___ watered while she was away.
questions.answer: be

questions.prompt: She said that they ___ not go anywhere if she didn't make up her mind.
questions.answer: would

questions.prompt: She said she ___ probably stay at home and look after the house.
questions.answer: would

questions.prompt: She told him that she ___ her brother about it the next day.
questions.answer: would ask

questions.prompt: She said that she ___ decide by the end of the week.
questions.answer: would

grammar.title: Grammar III: Change the indirect speech into direct speech
grammar.instruction: Change the indirect speech into direct speech according to the examples. 仿照例句将下列间接引语改为直接引语。
grammar.translation: Change the indirect speech into direct speech according to the printed examples.
grammar.key_source: pdf p.569 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 items converting indirect speech to direct speech; items 1 and 7 are printed examples (shown, not editable). Items 2-6, 8-12 are editable; answers from the answer key.

questions.prompt: He said that he liked it.
questions.answer: He said, “I like it.”

questions.prompt: She said that she was listening to the radio.
questions.answer: She said, “I am listening to the radio.”

questions.prompt: She said that he had told her about it.
questions.answer: She said, “He told me about it.”

questions.prompt: He said that she had been waiting for weeks.
questions.answer: He said, “She has been waiting for weeks.”

questions.prompt: He said that he had been thinking about it.
questions.answer: He said, “I have been thinking about it.”

questions.prompt: She said that he was strong enough to lift it.
questions.answer: She said, “He is strong enough to lift it.”

questions.prompt: He told his father that he wanted some money.
questions.answer: He told his father, “I want some money.”

questions.prompt: Tom told me that he had passed the test.
questions.answer: Tom told me, “I have passed the test.”

questions.prompt: She told him that she had never seen him before.
questions.answer: She told him, “I have never seen you before.”

questions.prompt: She told them that she was helping her mother.
questions.answer: She told them, “I am helping my mother.”

questions.prompt: He told me that he was going to go to England soon.
questions.answer: He told me, “I am going to go to England soon.”

questions.prompt: He told me that they had already retired.
questions.answer: He told me, “They have already retired.”

l134-pictures.description: Twelve numbered pictures in a 4x3 grid, each group of three showing: 1 a person saying 'I'm tired'; 2 a question mark bubble 'What did he say?'; 3 the same person with a speech bubble showing reported speech. Four groups illustrate: tired (past simple), reading (past continuous), dinner (past simple), homework (past perfect).
